formula.text: credit(unit) = groups_in_unit * (1 - p_unit); units are fixed 3-group batches by slot (slots 0-2, 3-5, 6-8; a partial unit is tested against the same 3-group null); p_unit = P(max group score of an honest 3-group unit >= this unit max) from the epoch out-of-sample null. credit_i = sum over the miner's verified units in the last 4 sealed epochs ending at the newest scored epoch (missing scores skipped). share_i = credit_i / sum_j credit_j over miners with >= 1 verified group(s) in the window AND >= 1 in the newest scored epoch (zero-groups floor: otherwise 0). Weight = share (mech 0, 100% to miners); if the newest valid score is older than 2 sealed epochs or nobody qualifies, 100% burns to UID 0. Group score = leave-task-out gradient dot with a reference drawn from the public post-commit block-hash seed.
